record.text: shift register as material — amber tape of folded parchment, text ghosting across sequential cells. each fold is a stage of the same data, displaced one step. the register is not storage. it is the motion of moving forward.

images.alt: shift register, step 0: text clear on the left, ghosted across the fold
shift register, step 1: one displacement, ghost trails one cell
shift register, step 2: displacement deepens, ghost fades
shift register, step 3: text ghosting across mid-sequence
shift register, step 4: ghost translucent, left edge fading
shift register, step 5: ghost nearly gone, right edge clear
shift register, step 6: ghost vanished, new text appears on the right
